title: Managed Ollama runtime and verified model controls
description: Managed Ollama runtime and verified model controls for the approved ARA-022 plan.
acceptance_criteria: Given an empty named store, when the default runtime starts, then no weights are downloaded/loaded and core API readiness remains independent.
Given a pull attempt, when pause acknowledges, then its transfer/checkpoints have settled, unrelated digest/inference work continues and retained ranges can resume.
Given a fresh daemon and unknown valid attempt UUID, when pause establishes a stop barrier, then late same-UUID pull is rejected before model I/O.
Given stock K2 architecture failure, when the reviewed patched source runs the exact 7B artifact, then native streaming/schema/thinking and resource evidence are recorded.
test_cases: Observed protocol routes 404 red; actual slow-registry transfer/range, retry cancellation and duplicate UUID green.
Observed unrelated HEAD/backpressured response cancellation reds and draining-client EOF correction; final ten controls repeated three times with race detector.
Observed unknown-pause tombstone/race/capacity reds then green; full Ollama server suite and final CPU image build.
Opt-in isolated exact-7B real pause/resume, stock architecture failure, patched engine and independent-pull/inference measurements.
verification: Independent runtime review cleared cancellation/initialization/backpressure/tombstone fixes. Reviewed CPU image f0c8e95243f7acbe5fdbc510830e1dd5622ae054a4fce1979db692cd80db14a5 passed ten control tests in repeated race runs and full server suite. Real 7B range resume/hash/stream/schema/thinking and app checks passed. Fresh ordinary Compose build/start passed with empty inventory/loaded-model lists and20.91MiB Ollama; CPU/NVIDIA/AMD Compose syntax validated. Actual source burst produced one restart per worker. Native amd64/GPU, 3.7B/27B untested.
